verses.text: Except Jehovah build the house, They labor in vain that build it: Except Jehovah keep the city, The watchman waketh but in vain.

segments.text: They labor in vain that build it:
The watchman waketh but in vain.

verses.text: It is vain for you to rise up early, To take rest late, To eat the bread of toil; For so he giveth unto his beloved sleep.

segments.text: It is vain for you to rise up early,
To eat the bread of toil;
so he giveth unto his beloved sleep.

verses.text: Lo, children are a heritage of Jehovah; And the fruit of the womb is his reward.

segments.text: Lo, children are a heritage of Jehovah;
the fruit of the womb is

verses.text: As arrows in the hand of a mighty man, So are the children of youth.

segments.text: As arrows in the hand of a mighty man,
So are the children of youth.

verses.text: Happy is the man that hath his quiver full of them: They shall not be put to shame, When they speak with their enemies in the gate.

segments.text: Happy is the man that hath his quiver full of them:
They shall not be put to shame,
When they speak with their enemies in the gate.

headings.text: A Song of Ascents; of Solomon.
